role_title: Senior Community Staff Nurse — Ashdown Park Community Healthcare
headline: Four years of autonomous district nursing on a rural caseload, which is the specific thing your last two hires were missing.

evidence.text: Registered, current, and unrestricted, with revalidation completed this year.
evidence.source_quote: NMC registered nurse (adult), registration current, no conditions or restrictions.

evidence.requirement: Three years post-registration, at least one in a community or district nursing setting
evidence.text: Five years post-registration, four of them in district nursing — comfortably past the threshold on the part that matters.
evidence.source_quote:
five years post-registration experience, four of them in
district nursing

evidence.requirement: Comfortable lone working with a rural caseload; full UK licence and own car
evidence.text: Has held a rural caseload of 20 to 30 housebound patients, visiting alone, and drives it daily.
evidence.source_quote:
Held an autonomous caseload of 20 to 30 housebound patients across a rural patch,
  visiting alone.

evidence.requirement: Independent wound assessment and management, including compression bandaging
evidence.text: Assesses and manages wounds independently, including compression bandaging for venous leg ulcers.
evidence.source_quote:
Carried out independent wound assessments and applied compression bandaging for venous
  leg ulcers

evidence.requirement: End-of-life care and syringe driver management
evidence.text: Runs syringe drivers on an end-of-life pathway and is signed off to verify expected death.
evidence.source_quote: Managed syringe drivers for patients on an end-of-life pathway

evidence.text: Uses SystmOne daily, has precepted two newly qualified nurses, and has said they want to start the V300.
evidence.source_quote: Used SystmOne daily for caseload management and clinical notes.

process_fit.text: Your Clinical Services Manager has told us what the first stage is really testing, and this candidate's whole record is the answer to it.
process_fit.source_quote:
clinical skill is the easy part and
what they cannot train is comfort with autonomy

process_fit.text: The question about the last independent call has a real answer here rather than a hypothetical one: four years of solo visits, with the nearest colleague a phone call away.
process_fit.source_quote:
They ask about the last time you made a
call on your own with nobody to check it with.

process_fit.text: The second-stage scenario tests escalation judgement, not clinical knowledge — and this candidate has been the person deciding whether to escalate, not the person with a ward team to escalate to.
process_fit.source_quote:
They are testing
escalation and documentation, not clinical knowledge.

process_fit.text: On the documentation point governance cares about: daily SystmOne use across a full caseload, plus a formal verification-of-expected-death competency, which is about as paper-trailed as community practice gets.
process_fit.source_quote: Anything that shows careful record-keeping lands well.

gaps.text: IV therapy is on their record, but from a surgical unit rather than in the community. Delivering it in someone's front room is a different job and we have no evidence they have done it there.
They are currently a Band 5 and this is a Band 6 equivalent post. The community experience is there; the formal step up is not.
The V300 is an expression of interest, not an enrolment. We have not seen a course place or a start date.
gaps.source_quote: Has expressed interest in starting the V300 non-medical prescribing course.

gaps.text: We have no evidence either way on how they handle a family disagreeing with a DNACPR decision, which was one of your recent second-stage scenarios.

open_questions: Confirm whether they have delivered IV therapy in a community setting, not just on the ward — this is the one essential where the CV is thin.
Ask directly about a DNACPR disagreement before second stage; it has come up on your panel and the CV says nothing about it.
Check their notice period. You have moved to offer within a week of second stage before, and we should know now whether they can meet that.
